name: forge-gate
description: Enforces the forge phase gate: shows whether the current phase's Verifiable gate is green on this exact working tree, and blocks a 'phase done' claim until it is. /gate runs it.

guardDoneClaims.title: Block 'phase done' claims
guardDoneClaims.description: When Claude says the phase is done while its gate is not green on the current tree, send it back once with the reason.
